title: Points & Rewards System
description: A configurable, system-agnostic player points and rewards framework for Foundry VTT with session voting, persistent Primary User identity, GM batch point awards, redeemable benefits, portable ecosystem configuration, World-stored Account-Wide or Character-Based balances, recovery transfers, integrity safeguards, chat announcements, and transaction history.

flags.contribution: Initial Points & Rewards System v0.0.1 implementation
